dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: What'd I tell you? You are, without a doubt, my best drinking buddy in all of Nod-Krai, hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: You're too kind, Mr. Varka. Truth is, though, I am but a dabbler when it comes to spirits. Yours, my friend, is a truly superior palate.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: #Ah, {NICKNAME}! What impeccable timing. Fancy a drink?

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: #I believe something on the milder side would be suitable for you, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: As it happens, Mr. Demyan is away on business. Allow me to prepare your drink in his stead. What'll it be then? Something sweet, or perhaps with a little tang to it?

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Ah, nothing like a bit of indulgence after a busy day on the road. Sweet and creamy ought to hit just right.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Something sweet, huh? Hey, how about mixing in that juice we had last time? Now that's what I call "hitting the sweet spot."

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: In all our gatherings, Mr. Varka, I don't believe we have ever partaken in what one might call "juice."

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: You're referring to the bottle of "Sakura Sake" imported from Inazuma, I presume? Hehe, if I remember correctly, that tiny vial was the undoing of four patrons.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: "Sakura Sake"? That's odd, I don't recall it having much of a taste at all. But I remember those "Pickled Sakura" were delicious, and they were perfect with alcohol.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Here you go. It may be nameless, but I'm confident it'll lift your spirits.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Miss Paimon, allow me to present this freshly squeezed juice. I've included a bit of pulp to further enhance its texture.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow! Thank you, hehe!

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Mr. Varka, have a sip of this.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Oh? I get a serving too? What's this, the sobering-up round after the party?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: This is... the taste of Wolfhook! Hahaha, where did you even get this? When?

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Your longing for Mondstadt is quite evident, and I happen to have an eye for such subtleties. In any case, I trust that this fruit shall bring you some measure of cheer.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Not bad at all. Shame, though... Can't find anyone else to keep me company on marathon drinking sessions here in Nod-Krai.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: That said, I don't think you've ever quite drunk your fill.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: If you're referring to the experience of being utterly absorbed in exquisite wine, allowing one's thoughts to wander freely, and relishing the act of doing so... then I suppose...

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Vanishes without a trace. But while certain robust spirits may ignite a blaze, I can't say it's ever really made me feel that way.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Ha, that's only because the stuff we've got isn't strong enough! Like the "Fire-Water" from Snezhnaya, you've definitely tried that before, right?

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Hahaha, of course. But it's been some time now, so my recollection has grown faint.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: I'll get us a barrel one of these days. Then we can drink to our heart's content.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: I shall defer to your judgment, Mr. Varka. First, however, allow me to raise a toast to this most pleasant evening encounter.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Alright, hahaha, cheers!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Cheers!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Cheers!

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Here's to a delightful evening.

choices.text: Ahem, I mean, when alcohol meets flame, it...

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Hmm... You seem a little tired. Something tangy to invigorate the senses, maybe... Perhaps a splash of lemon juice?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Can't say I've ever had any sour liquor before. Closest I get is drinking something sour after the alcohol to sober up.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Actually, now that I think about it, it's been a long time since I tasted Noelle's hangover soup. She'd always toss in Wolfhooks and Berry juice.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: *sigh* My drinking stamina's really taken a hit without it. The thought of it makes me wanna head back to Mondstadt...
